title: App profile log mode and log file size

prose.text: {{default-follows-global}} {{global-default-for-new}} Whether a change to the global mode reaches existing profiles left on the default is open {{gap:global-change-existing}}. {{log-mode-ladder}}

prose.label: In the API.
prose.text: The API fields `logMode` and `logLevel`, their codes and what is still open about them are in [[zcc.logging.log-modes]].

Whether users can change the log mode, export or clear logs is set on the App Supportability page: [[zcc.logging.user-access]]. What the app may collect and who may read the log folder is [[zcc.web-privacy.collection]].

default-follows-global.statement: A profile's log mode defaults to the global log mode configured in Platform Settings, and can be overridden for that profile only.

evidence.after: The Add Windows Policy window appears.
quotes: Default (Current: <log mode>): Displays the default global log mode configured in Platform Settings. You can override this setting, for the current profile only, by selecting a different option from the drop-down menu.

global-default-for-new.statement: The Default Global Log Mode article says a default global log mode, set on the Platform Settings tab, can be configured for new profiles, and that it can be overridden for individual profiles in App Profiles.

quotes: You can configure a default global log mode for new profiles.
You can override this setting for individual profiles in App Profiles.

log-mode-ladder.statement: The modes are cumulative: Error logs only errors that affect functionality, Warn adds potential issues, Info adds general activity, and Debug logs all activity that could help Zscaler Support.

evidence.after: The Add Windows Policy window appears.
quotes: Error: Zscaler Client Connector logs only when the app encounters an error and functionality is affected.
Warn: Zscaler Client Connector logs when the app is functioning but is encountering potential issues, or when conditions for the Error log mode are met.
Info: Zscaler Client Connector logs general app activity, or when conditions for the Warn log mode are met.
Debug: Zscaler Client Connector logs all app activity that could assist Zscaler Support in debugging issues, or when conditions for the Info log mode are met.

log-file-size.statement: Log file size is 50 to 1000 MB (50 to 500 on Android), 100 MB per log type by default; at the limit the oldest logs are truncated.

evidence.after: The Add Windows Policy window appears.
quotes: Enter a value between 50 and 1000 to specify the maximum size of the log file. The default log file size is 100 MB per log type.
When logs reach the maximum file size, the oldest logs are truncated from the file to keep the file size below the maximum.

global-change-existing.title: Whether changing the global log mode changes existing profiles left on the default
global-change-existing.detail: The Default Global Log Mode article says the global mode is a default for new profiles and can be overridden per profile; the app profile page says a profile's log mode shows the global mode as its default. Neither says whether a later change to the global mode reaches profiles that already exist and are left on the default.
